scenarios.title: Player buys 10 of NPC 100-unit native Rust ask
steps: Deploy reversed-testable COOP-034, 035, 047 Rust overlays in disposable checkout
Prepare real NPC native produced item, Rust open ask with 100 units and corporation wallet
Buy 10 via authenticated player order flow with durable claimKey
expected: One new globally allocated native itemID owned by buyer with 10 units
Original native escrowed itemID retains exactly 90 units
Player ISK debit equals NPC corporation wallet credit
Rust vol_remaining=90 and state open
requiredEvidence: GameStore buyer and corporation ISK ledgers

scenarios.title: Two buyers race for the same remaining stack
steps: Create one verified native corporate ask
Start two concurrent Rust claim attempts from different authenticated buyers
Finalize winner with native GameStore receipt and retry losing request
expected: Exactly one claim enters SETTLING
Second buyer cannot debit or obtain phantom items
Physical item and ISK conservation proven by durable receipts
requiredEvidence: GameStore buyer and corporation ISK ledgers

scenarios.title: Last partial buyer takes remaining original item
steps: Sell 20 units from 100-unit original stack
Buy remaining 80 with new unique claimKey and native fillID
Restart Rust and GameStore before rereading order
expected: Original itemID transfers to final buyer with quantity=80
Earlier 20-unit buyer item remains unchanged
Escrow row removed and Rust order FILLED
No quantity-zero original stack
requiredEvidence: GameStore buyer and corporation ISK ledgers

scenarios.title: Lost claim ACK after Rust commits
steps: Persist request claimKey before sending Rust claim RPC
Commit Rust SETTLING then drop successful network acknowledgement
Restart client/server and retry exact claimKey
expected: Rust returns identical fill ID and remaining_before
No second claim or extra debit
Unresolved claim remains isolated from other buyers
requiredEvidence: GameStore buyer and corporation ISK ledgers

scenarios.title: Lost finalization ACK after native SQLite commit
steps: Commit all six GameStore tables and native receipt

expected: GameStore no duplicate buyer itemID or wallet journal

All quantities and ISK match initial conservation

scenarios.title: Fault during native item/ISK atomic transaction
